_meta.description: Starter labels copied to /etc/dpp-analytics/product_labels.json on first deployment only. Runtime edits belong in the host-side file and are never overwritten by Git pulls.

fields.name: Short display name used on the board
fields.image_url: Optional manual image override; normally populated automatically from Amazon Catalog Items
fields.amazon_url: Optional manual product-page override; otherwise built from the SKU's ASIN
